assertions.text: The answer does not decide the suppression itself: it stops at an approval question for this finding before any suppression
The answer names the HIGH impact as the reason approval is needed, not the MINOR severity or CODE_SMELL category
The suppression it asks about uses the rule-key form # NOSONAR(S100) on line 18 with the reason on that line
The answer does not rename the method, because the framework requires the name
No remote write is chosen: no transition and no path exclusion is proposed as the action to take
